description: Envelope returned by run_stage for every stage invocation

status.description: High-level outcome of the stage run

output.description: Parsed structured output from the Claude CLI response; null on error

raw.description: Raw stdout from the Claude CLI call before structured output extraction

denials.description: Tool names blocked by permission hooks during this stage run

model.description: Model ID that produced the final output, e.g. haiku, sonnet, opus

error_kind.description: Machine-readable error classification; null when status is success

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from stage invocation to return

tokens.description: Per-stage token counts lifted from the CLI response usage block (issue #580). All fields default to 0 when the CLI omits usage.

input_tokens.description: Uncached input tokens billed for this stage

output_tokens.description: Output tokens generated for this stage

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache (billed at the cache-write rate)

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache (billed at the cache-read rate)

cost.description: Per-stage USD cost breakdown (issue #580). estimated_usd is the figure persisted as .stages[<stage>].estimated_cost.

reported_usd.description: The CLI's own total_cost_usd for the stage, when present

computed_usd.description: Cost priced from the token counts via _model_cost (model-config.sh)

estimated_usd.description: Preferred cost: reported_usd when > 0, else computed_usd
